android.intro: Add Scorize Panel to your home screen for quick access.
android.menu: Open this page in Chrome and tap the three-dot menu (⋮).
android.addToHome: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
android.confirm: Follow the on-screen steps to add Scorize Panel.

iphone.handoff: Copy the panel link and paste it into Safari’s address bar to add Scorize Panel to your Home Screen.
iphone.copied: Panel link copied. Paste it into Safari.
iphone.copyManually: Touch and hold the panel link to copy it.
iphone.shareHint: Tap this icon in Safari’s toolbar, or choose Share from More (⋯).
iphone.addToHomeHint: Scroll down in the Share menu. If it’s missing, tap Edit Actions.
iphone.confirmHint: Leave Open as Web App on if shown. Scorize will appear on your Home Screen.
